_comment: Targets config for scripts/generate-opening-lines.ts. Each key is an opening id (matches src/openings/lessons.ts course key). 'rootMoves' walks the frequency tree to the opening's entry position; 'branchPlies' is how deep past root to expand (8 ≈ 4 full moves of variation); 'maxBranchesPerNode' caps the fan-out per ply (3 means top-3 most-played continuations); 'minFrequencyPct' drops moves played in <N% of master games at that node.
_note: Start with the 4 thin courses (London, Vienna, Scandinavian, Pirc). Once those produce good output, add the rest.
